ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white surface comprising approximately 75-80% of the visible area, contrasted against a low-intensity black perimeter and scattered focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black boundary along the leading and trailing edges; distinct yellow-brown organic mottling in the medial sections of both lobes; non-uniform black focal clusters concentrated on the distal tips and lower central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree interior angle, exhibiting significant depth relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge, with increased complexity and jaggedness on the outer distal lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave upward sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular black pigment spots visible on the left-mid lobe; small white circular scars (likely barnacle attachment points) visible on the black trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal black rake marks; one prominent horizontal linear disruption on the left lobe and several intersecting vertical marks near the fluke base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss on the far-right trailing edge; significant brownish-yellow pigmentation patches indicative of algal colonization or staining on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical black pigmentation line extending upward from the apex of the median notch into the center of the ventral surface.
